component.name: Klinker
component.summary: Choose which browser opens a link, or route links by rules

description.p: Klinker is a link handler for KDE Plasma. Set it as the default web browser and every link either opens in the browser chosen by your routing rules, or shows a small keyboard-driven chooser with your installed browsers.
Optional privacy features remove tracking parameters and resolve redirects before a browser is chosen. Browsers are started directly with an argument list, never through a shell.
The Flatpak starts the browsers installed on your system, outside its sandbox, so it is granted permission to run programs on the host.

screenshot.caption: The chooser as a horizontal strip of browsers

description.p: Flatpak support: browsers are found and started on the host system.
